$comment: The tracking plan (Measurement & Tracking Specification, section 3). Every event the website pushes to the GTM dataLayer, who pushes it, and what it carries. A template or feature is not done until its events are here and covered by tests/tracking. The container (GTM-5VKC5CMT) is built on these names; docs/gtm-container-setup.md maps each one to its tags.

page_metadata.pushed_by: server (src/server.ts) before the container loads; TagLayerService repeats it on every in-app event

keys.page_type: home | page | landing | article | product | author | doctor_profile | hospital_profile | <kind>_listing | search_results | order_tracking | not_found
keys.journey_stage: know | find | act, from the CMS
keys.care_category: from the CMS when sent, else hospital | insurance | emergency | doctor from content_group, else null
keys.clarity_allowed: true only on a standard CMS page

events.when: an in-app route change (not the first page, which the server described)
events.tested_by: tests/tracking: an in-app move to a sensitive page

events.when: the API saved a form submission (not on duplicate: true)
events.gtm: CE - generate_lead → GA4 + GAds - Conv - Lead

events.when: the API saved a purchase request (not on duplicate: true)
a CMS button or link is clicked
search results, or the doctors / hospitals / products index, are shown
right after search_results_view when result_count is 0
the API refused a submit (not the browser's own checks)
a wa.me, tel:+20… or store link is clicked anywhere on the page
events.pushed_by: GTM link-click triggers only — the site pushes nothing, so a click has one source
events.gtm: Click - WhatsApp / Click - Phone / Click - App store → GA4 + GAds conversions

not_on_the_website.$comment: In the spec, but the action happens in the app, not on the website. Add here when a website flow exists.

whatsapp_ref.$comment: Spec §8. Not a dataLayer event: a code on the chat itself, so a WhatsApp conversation can be traced to its campaign in the CRM.
whatsapp_ref.when: a tap on any wa.me / api.whatsapp.com / whatsapp:// link (CMS button or footer)
whatsapp_ref.done_by: WhatsappRefService (installed by SiteShellComponent), capture phase, before the tag manager reads the URL
whatsapp_ref.code: H- + 7 chars from 23456789ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTUVWXYZ, one per visit (sessionStorage)
whatsapp_ref.message: appended to the link text: "رقم المرجع: H-…" / "Ref: H-…"
whatsapp_ref.api: POST /api/v1/public/{locale}/whatsapp-refs by sendBeacon, text/plain JSON {ref, page_path, cta_tracking_key, attribution}
whatsapp_ref.dashboard: Leads → WhatsApp code: look up, then create a lead carrying the attribution
